model_findings.explanation: The built-in Review start is refused whenever taskUsesGreenhouseReviewProvider(change, cfg, "") is true. For a workspace with mixed frozen per-Member providers, that aggregate is true if any Member uses Greenhouse, so builtin Members cannot receive their required host Review at all. The corresponding auto-start path likewise treats the whole workspace as Greenhouse and does not start builtin review for builtin Members.
model_findings.action: Evaluate the provider per changed workspace Member and only suppress or route the Review for Greenhouse Members; continue scheduling the builtin Review path for Members frozen to builtin.

model_findings.explanation: The new prepublication gate path reuses startParallelGreenhouseReviews, whose request deduplication treats any settled Greenhouse request for the same Task, repository, and head as sufficient to skip starting another review. A prior shadow/parallel Verdict therefore prevents the required gate review from being launched, leaving the Task without a gate Verdict and unable to publish or merge.
model_findings.action: Make review-request deduplication mode-aware: a settled parallel request must not suppress a gate request, and gate reconciliation must launch or recognize a settled gate request independently.

model_findings.explanation: GreenhouseGatePass selects the latest Verdict for the repository across both gate and parallel modes, then applies Qualifies. A later shadow parallel Verdict consequently invalidates an otherwise current passing gate Verdict, even though review_parallel is explicitly a non-gating shadow path. This can block publish and merge after a valid gate pass.
model_findings.action: Select the latest gate Verdict for the repository when evaluating the gate, while still invalidating older gate passes when a newer gate Verdict for another head or an inconclusive/failed gate result exists; do not let parallel Verdicts affect gate eligibility.
